comment: The bindings' component addresses (docs/design/presentations.md V4): a binding matches a component type by the prop keys its props carry (`exact`: those and no others; `optional`, with `exact`: keys a build's call may also carry, so one address holds across builds whose call gained or lost a prop). `needs` are the build-time seams and exposures it uses: framework-main arms it only on a pack whose seams.hooks delivers them all. `canary` is the props it expects at its first match, by type ('string', 'boolean', 'number', 'object', 'array', 'function', 'any'; a trailing '?' allows null or absent): a component type whose props fail it is never wrapped and the binding is off for the page (boundary review 4a). framework-main sends the armed ones to the page kernel at document start; the runtime's binding of the same id renders them. `presentation` names the presentation type (docs/graph/03) a binding or rule realizes (coverage, docs/design/breadth.md §3); `rules` are runtime rules, not component bindings. Never minified names.
